Senior Python Backend Engineer

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Python backend engineer to design and operate
scalable microservices for our fintech platform. You will own service design,
API contracts, and CI/CD quality.

Responsibilities:
- Design REST APIs and microservices in Python (FastAPI or Django).
- Operate services on Docker and Kubernetes in AWS.
- Build CI/CD pipelines and code review culture.
- Collaborate with data and frontend teams in agile sprints.

Requirements:
- At least 5 years of experience with Python backend development.
- Strong SQL knowledge with PostgreSQL.
- Hands-on Docker and Kubernetes experience.
- Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools.

Nice to have:
- Experience with Kafka or other message queues.
- AWS or GCP cloud experience.

Data Scientist

Description:
We are hiring a data scientist to design machine learning and NLP models that
power our recommendation and risk scoring products.

Responsibilities:
- Build classification and ranking models with scikit-learn or PyTorch.
- Design experiment and evaluation protocols with offline metrics.
- Work with engineers to deploy models in production.

Requirements:
- Minimum 3 years of experience in machine learning or data science.
- Strong Python skills with pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn.
- SQL knowledge for working with large datasets.
- Familiarity with NLP and text mining techniques.

Nice to have:
- Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Cloud experience on AWS or GCP.
- Familiarity with Spark or distributed data tools.

Senior DevOps / SRE Engineer

Description:
We are looking for a senior DevOps / SRE engineer to operate our cloud-native
platform across AWS and GCP. You will own infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD,
observability, and incident response.

Responsibilities:
- Operate Kubernetes clusters in production.
- Design CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
- Build infrastructure as code with Terraform.
- Improve observability, on-call practices, and security hardening.

Requirements:
- At least 5 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering.
- Strong Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes experience.
- Hands-on AWS or GCP cloud experience.
- Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tooling.

Nice to have:
- Python or Bash automation experience.
- Background in agile teams.
